results.title: Carry forward concessional contributions | ART
results.description:
# Carry forward concessional contributions
## What are carry forward concessional contributions?
### What's the concessional contributions cap?
It's currently set to $32,500.

## How to use carry forward concessional contributions
- You'll then be able to make concessional super contributions up to $32,500, plus any leftovers from previous years. Just remember concessional contributions also include the SG payments from your employer.

#### Not sure how much you should be contributing to super?
[Use our contributions calculator](https://www.australianretirementtrust.com.au/learn/tools/super-contributions-calculator)

results.title: Carry-forward super contributions explained (2026–27) - SuperGuide
results.description:
# Carry-forward super contributions explained (2026–27)
## What are carry-forward contributions?
### Expiry of unused concessional contributions caps
| **Financial year** | **Concessional cap for the year** | **Last financial year in which unused cap can be used** |
|-|-|-|
| 2021–22 | $27,500 | 2026–27 |
| 2022–23 | $27,500 | 2027–28 |
| 2023–24 | $27,500 | 2028–29 |
| 2024–25 | $30,000 | 2029–30 |
| 2025–26 | $30,000 | 2030-31 |
| 2026–27 | $32,500 | 2031-32 |

## How carry-forward contributions work: Case studies
|  | **2021–22** | **2022–23** | **2023–24** | 2024–25 | 2025–26 |
|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Annual general concessional contributions cap | $27,500 | $27,500 | $27,500 | $30,000 | $30,000 |
| Concessional contributions into Kylie’s account | $10,000 | $10,000 | $10,000 | $15,000 | $15,000 |
| Available unused concessional cap | $17,500 | $17,500 | $17,500 | $15,000 | $15,000 |
| **Cumulative available unused concessional cap** | **$17,500** | **$35,000** | **$52,500** | **$67,500** | **$82,500** |

Arun calculates that his employer will contribute $19,000 during the year, so he makes a personal tax-deductible contribution of $33,500, for total concessional contributions of $52,500 ($32,500 annual cap plus $20,000 carried forward).
